notes.title: v1.1.0_update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=o1YL3es_kvg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]v1.1.0[/h1]

[b]added[/b]
[list]
[*] 7 unlockable skins
[*] challenge mode leaderboard for best time
[*] 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place crown cosmetics for top 3 players on each leaderboard
[*] leaderboard viewer buttons on main menu
[*] quick restart button in pause menu
[*] quit confirm button
[/list]

[b]changed[/b]
[list]
[*] challenge mode is now a time attack
[*] quick restart hotkey is now ctrl + r
[/list]

[b]fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] cursor now lines up with actual cursor position on all monitor ratios
[*] lasers should no longer hang, for real this time
[*] player can no longer shoot posthumously
[*] misc ui improvements and fixes
[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.3_patch_notes
notes.content:
hello serpents - we've got a few little fixes implemented. we also have some neat new features coming down the pipeline, so stay tuned for those. here's what got added patch:

[b]added[/b]
[list]
[*] dash charge indicator
[/list]
[b]changed[/b]
[list]
[*] enemy projectiles now disappear 0.25 seconds after the enemy is killed
[*] minor ui improvement
[/list]
[b]fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] lasers should now all destroy on player death
[*] player should not die immediately after spawning
[*] bug resolved where final achievement was not unlockable for some
[*] minor ui bugfixes
[/list]
